items.statementText:
SELECT DBMS_CLOUD_AI.GENERATE(
             prompt       => 'Which five components have the highest scheduled material value? Sum production_order_lines.line_total only for released, in_production, or completed production_orders. Status values are case-sensitive lowercase strings: use order_status IN (''released'', ''in_production'', ''completed'') exactly; do not uppercase them.',
             profile_name => 'genai',
             action       => 'showsql'
           ) AS generated_sql

items.generated_sql:
SELECT c.COMPONENT_NAME, SUM(pol.LINE_TOTAL) AS total_material_value
FROM "LLUSER"."COMPONENTS" c
JOIN "LLUSER"."PRODUCTION_ORDER_LINES" pol ON c.COMPONENT_ID = pol.COMPONENT_ID
JOIN "LLUSER"."PRODUCTION_ORDERS" po ON pol.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID = po.PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID
WHERE po.ORDER_STATUS IN ('released', 'in_production', 'completed')
GROUP BY c.COMPONENT_NAME
ORDER BY total_material_value DESC
FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
